plan: [This auction functions like a second-price (Vickrey) mechanism: your sealed bid sets your exit and the winner pays the second-highest sealed bid. With independent private values and random tie-breaking, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy and maximizes expected payoff. No prior history to update, so I will bid my private value of 39 to maximize long-run profit.]

[This sealed-bid + clock mechanism is effectively a second-price (Vickrey) auction: the winner pays the second-highest sealed bid. In a second-price auction, bidding your true private value is a dominant strategy and maximizes long-run profit. My private value is $13, so I will bid $13. This avoids overpaying while ensuring optimal chance to win when profitable.]
